scope: Static Go AST inventory of every character StatMod/AttackMod Amount callback in the two final build source roots. No source changes, app build, or tests were performed.

method.scanner: Go parser/AST over non-test .go files under internal/characters; identifies AddStatMod/AddAttackMod calls, resolves direct Amount composite literals and same-file named mod composite assignments, traverses each Amount function body, return expressions, and bridge call names.

categorySemantics.fixed-bridge: Amount body calls CharacterModifierVector; native Go retains original gates and nil paths.
categorySemantics.dynamic-read: Amount body calls CharacterModifierDynamicRead. A callback may additionally call CharacterModifierSnapshot; that operation remains in bridgeOperations.
categorySemantics.creation-snapshot: Amount body calls CharacterModifierSnapshot to attach creation calculation IDs to the original stored vector.
categorySemantics.residual-vector: A non-nil vector-returning path with no recognized vector bridge call in the Amount body.
categorySemantics.nil-only: All syntactic return expressions in Amount are nil; this only describes vector return values and does not imply absence of callback side effects.

method.noStringContainmentClaim: A source file containing a bridge call does not classify its callbacks as bridged; classification is per AST Amount function body and actual return path.

coverageLimits: AST classification proves call-site structure, not formula correctness or runtime equivalence.
The callback index preserves every registered Amount site and exclusive category; verbatim bodies are embedded for every residual and nil-only callback.
The scanner excludes *_test.go and non-character packages, matching the character-modifier inventory scope.
Nil-only callbacks can still mutate AttackEvent.FlatDmg; Clorinde A1 and Xilonen C6 are explicit side-effect boundaries.
The sole residual non-nil vector is Wanderer A1 Cryo; its original body and producer slot are preserved per lane.
